newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 2.4 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 2.4 pct in August.

text.p: Swiss retail sales, measured by value, fell 2.4 percent in August from the same month last year after a year-on-year decline of 0.4 percent in July, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Retail sales rose by 2.7 percent in August 1995.

Sales of foods and luxury items declined by 3.4 percent during the month whereas sales of clothing and textile items were up slightly for the first time in eight months, recording an increase of 0.7 percent, the office said.
Turnover was down by a total 2.1 percent in all other sectors, it added.
For the first eight months of 1996, the value of retail sales was 0.9 percent lower than in the same period of last year.
Adjusted for inflation, the August and eight-month declines were also reported at 2.4 percent and 0.9 percent, respectively.
